notes.title: Patch #3 - Version 1.0.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27166411/c9ddaf311a85b0f42636926e860e770d970d0cdc.png[/img]

Hello fellow gamers,
here a new important update for the game!

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Changed the Alchemy Set minigame.
[*] Changed the Eco-Engine minigame.
[*] Proofreading of all the game texts (English and Italian).
[*] Added three more OST tracks.
[*] Some minor fixes.
[/list]

Coming soon:
[list]
[*] The other few missing tracks to complete the OST for the Act I.
[*] The free DLC for the Act II.
[*] Act II trailer.
[/list]

Cheers and keep having fun!

notes.title: New Patch - Version 0.9.92
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27166411/c9ddaf311a85b0f42636926e860e770d970d0cdc.png[/img]

Hello fellow gamers,
here we are with another update for the game!

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Mac support added.
[*] Some typo corrections.
[*] Some game menu minor fixes.
[*] Added a confirmation window when skipping the alchemic minigame.
[*] The mouse pointer will now be hidden during dialogues with no options (you still have to click to go forward in the dialogue).
[/list]

Coming soon:
[list]
[*] New OST tracks to complete the full OST of the game.
[/list]

Cheers, keep having fun, and happy new year!

notes.title: First Patch - Version 0.9.91
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27166411/c9ddaf311a85b0f42636926e860e770d970d0cdc.png[/img]

Hello fellow gamers,
here we are with the first small update: it has been reported to us that in the English version of the game, in the alchemic minigame, some text wasn't visible; moreover some sound effect were played always at full volume. 

We just fixed it! ːTerrySmileː

Fixes:
[list]
[*] The English alchemic minigame now correctly show the result text.
[*] All the sound fx of the game are now played at the correct volume.
[/list]

Coming soon:
[list]
[*] A confirmation window when skipping the alchemic minigame.
[*] New OST tracks to complete the full OST of the game.
[/list]

Cheers and keep having fun!
